title: Distributed Homelab Infrastructure
blurb: A from-scratch home datacenter — network, storage, and a fully local AI stack, no cloud.
detail: PoE-powered Raspberry Pi nodes handle DNS filtering and Home Assistant automation; a ZFS mirrored NAS backs file storage and a media server; a local AI voice assistant runs Whisper speech-to-text with Ollama LLM inference; and custom ESP32 mic/speaker nodes tie the whole thing together.

title: Custom PCB Design
blurb: Three boards taken from schematic to fabrication-ready Gerbers — including the from-scratch ESP32 dev board rendered here.
detail: A hands-on run through the full KiCad workflow: schematic capture, layout, design-rule checks, footprint assignment, and Gerber export for fabrication. The set included a breadboard power supply, a solar power regulator, and an ESP32 development board built from scratch — drag the model to inspect the board.

title: Aircraft Data Acquisition System
blurb: A battery-powered DAQ prototype for capturing flight sensor data and streaming it live over RF.
detail: Designed custom PCBs with regulated power supplies, Wheatstone-bridge signal conditioning, and optocoupler isolation for noise-sensitive vibration, temperature, humidity, and acoustic channels. STM32 and Artemis firmware handled synchronized sampling, SD logging, and a touchscreen UI, streaming over RF to a handheld unit. MIL-STD-810G environmental conditions were the design target.

title: Arch Linux Dotfiles
blurb: A version-controlled Arch Linux setup for a fast, keyboard-driven development environment — an exercise in reproducible, scriptable configuration.

title: FPV Drone Design & Build
blurb: A 5-inch quad built from parts: soldered electronics, an ELRS radio link, GPS telemetry with battery fail-safes, and PID tuning for stabilized GoPro footage.

title: Ecodistrict Smart-Home Mockup
blurb: Photovoltaic-powered smart-home nodes publishing MQTT telemetry to a centralized Raspberry Pi energy manager, coordinated with a simulated solar source.
